outcome: Cesarean section due to fetal distress
finding: Decreased cerebroplacental ratio (CPR) in appropriate for gestational age (AGA) fetuses was associated with an increased rate of cesarean sections due to fetal distress and impaired neonatal outcomes, including lower birth weight, increased transfer to neonatology, longer hospitalization, and higher rates of severe morbidity.
mod_finding: This study found that a decreased cerebroplacental ratio in appropriate for gestational age fetuses was associated with a threefold increased rate of cesarean sections due to fetal distress.
